rationale: Adds a background prewarm of a scripted editor's caches (QuickJS bytecode compile and materialized-document verification) at plug-in instantiation, an in-flight wait in those two process-wide caches, the exact runtime-import payload/inline script sources factored into one helper the pipeline and the prewarm share, a trace-autostart file for traced builds, and an out-of-process editor-open probe. The imported document, its decode and SHA-256 verification, the evaluated sources and the rendered output are byte-for-byte unchanged; only when the work happens moves. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
